description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key (a free key is enough). Entries from the SpaceNexus Promise Ledger: dated public commitments about spaceflight by agencies, companies and executives, each with the verbatim quote, who said it and when, the deadline as stated and normalised, the status shown today, the outcome and its source, and every later revision. Filter by party, status, claim type or words; page with offset.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1 to 25).

offset.description: Entries to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

party.description: An organisation or a person: name or slug, e.g. "SpaceX", "NASA", "elon-musk".

query.description: Words to find in the claim, quote or context.

status.description: Only entries shown with this status today.

name: promise_ledger_entries
title: Promise Ledger entries
